title: Remote Receptionist
description:
Bilgewater Group is a Chicago-based diversified services company founded in 2003. We operate across two core divisions: food service and care.
Our food service division manages a network of quick-service and counter-service locations across the greater Chicagoland area, serving thousands of customers every day at high-traffic venues, including commercial districts, transit hubs, and retail centers.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Remote Receptionist to serve as a first point of contact for customers, visitors, and internal teams. You will handle incoming calls and messages, provide basic information, route requests to the appropriate team, and support day-to-day administrative tasks.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Answer incoming calls, messages, and general inquiries

• Provide basic information and assistance to customers and other contacts

• Direct calls and requests to the appropriate team or location

• Schedule appointments and coordinate basic requests

• Maintain contact information and administrative records

• Follow up on requests when needed

• Provide general administrative support to the team

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Previous experience in reception, customer service, administration, hospitality, or a similar role

• Professional and friendly communication style

• Strong organization and attention to detail

• Comfortable handling calls, messages, and multiple requests

• Basic computer and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace skills

• Reliable and comfortable working independently in a remote environment

• Reliable internet connection and workspace

• Legally authorized to work in the United States

NICE TO HAVE

• Previous remote receptionist or virtual receptionist experience

• Experience with scheduling or appointment management

• Experience in food service, hospitality, retail, or care environments

• Bilingual communication skills - English / Spanish

COMPENSATION
$18-$24 per hour , depending on experience and qualifications.
HIRING PROCESS
Application Review → Initial Conversation → Interview → Offer
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Bilgewater Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and value a diverse team with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
Location: Remote

Through consultative relationships, strong prioritization, repeatable playbooks, and scalable engagement, you will drive retention, product adoption, and expansion across your book of business.

We’ve laid out the experience we think is important to set you up for success in this role. But, we appreciate that different humans will solve problems in different ways, so we don’t expect you to fit exactly in a box of requirements.

• Use merchant goals, health signals, engagement, product usage, and renewal timing to prioritize your book of business and determine where proactive intervention will have the greatest impact.

• Lead complex renewal and commercial conversations, clearly articulating Loop 's value and competitive differentiation to stakeholders across the merchant's organization.

• You’ll partner cross-functionally with Account Executives to cross-sell our products to your existing merchant base.

• You’ve managed accounts for a long enough period of time that you oversaw the renewal process with them, and have successfully renewed many accounts.

• You know what it’s like to be accountable for revenue goals, and you’ve accomplished (or exceeded!) them in the past.

• You have tried to find true ways to uncover and close new opportunities with accounts, and are willing to share a few examples with us.

Challenge: Build impactful consultative relationships with your merchants to drive additional value through Loop .

• Host quarterly business reviews with your key accounts, showing up with content that aligns merchants priorities to Loop 's capabilities and the outcomes that matter most to their business.

• Engage in regular, creative touchpoints with your accounts to get in front of any issues prior to renewal and avoid merchant churn.

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
Robotics Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Robotics Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $70,000-$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Robotics Engineer to design, build, and integrate software systems that power autonomous robots and robotic platforms. In this role you will work across the full robotics software stack, from low-level sensor integration and motion planning to high-level perception and behavioral systems. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep working knowledge of robotics frameworks, real-time systems, and sensor fusion. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Five or more years of robotics software engineering experience.

• Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.

• Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS 2 in production projects.

• Solid experience with at least one of perception, localization, motion planning, or control.

• Familiarity with sensor fusion and Kalman/particle filter techniques.

• Experience with simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo).

• Strong debugging skills in real-time and concurrent systems.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

• Experience supporting field tests and hardware integration.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree in Robotics or related field.

• Exposure to autonomous vehicles, drones, or industrial automation.

• Experience with safety-critical software (ISO 26262, IEC 61508).

• Familiarity with ML-based perception pipelines.

• Open-source contributions in robotics.

title: Structural Engineer – Substation
description:
Company Description

We are Olsson . We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results - for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson . It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description
Imagine being part of a team that supports the backbone of the electric grid. As a Structural Engineer - Substation, you will play a critical role in the planning, design, and delivery of substation infrastructure across Olsson ’s Transmission and Substation team.
In this role, you will lead the structural design of substation foundations, steel structures, and equipment supports, contributing to projects that strengthen and modernize power delivery systems. You will collaborate closely with electrical engineers, designers, and project managers throughout all phases of project delivery.
This position is ideal for a structural engineer who enjoys technically challenging work, mentoring others, and contributing meaningfully to essential infrastructure projects.
Key Responsibilities:

• Structural Design & Analysis: Perform and lead structural design for substation facilities, including foundations, steel structures, equipment supports, and miscellaneous structural components.

• Project Delivery: Support projects through all phases including conceptual design, detailed engineering, permitting support, and construction administration.

• Coordination & Collaboration: Work closely with electrical engineers, designers, and other disciplines to ensure coordinated, constructible designs.

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance and review of designs prepared by junior engineers and designers.

• Client & Field Interaction: Participate in client meetings, respond to contractor RFIs, and provide construction support as needed, including limited travel to project sites.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

• Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering (structural emphasis).

• 6+ years of progressive structural engineering experience, preferably including substation or industrial facilities.

• Experience designing concrete foundations and structural steel systems.

• Working knowledge of relevant codes and standards (ACI, AISC, IBC, ASCE).

• Strong communication, organizational, and problem‑solving skills.

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure preferred or ability to obtain within a reasonable timeframe.

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

• Receive a competitive 401(k) match

• Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths

• Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements

• Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities

• Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it’s at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

The Regional People Partner is the key connective tissue between our Airport Operations leaders and their teams. Across your region, you're the person leaders lean on to make good calls, and the person team members know is invested in their success. This role puts you in the middle of it all: coaching station leaders, solving employee relations issues, and building exceptional team member experience that help CLEAR thrive.

 

What you'll do:

• Be the go-to People Partner for Operations leaders in your region - the person they call when something's tricky, not just when something's already broken.

• Coach and sharpen station leaders and managers - through training, real feedback, recognition that means something, and just showing up when it counts.

• Own employee and labor relations across your stations: run investigations, dig into root causes, and land on outcomes that are fair and consistent, working closely with Legal along the way.

• Turn employee data, survey results, and what you're hearing on the ground into recommendations leaders can actually act on.

• Partner across People and Operations on the bigger initiatives: onboarding, process fixes, and making sure People practices run the same way at every station.

 

How you'll measure success:

• Fewer repeat employee relations issues, and faster, smarter resolution when they do come up.

• Engagement and retention trending up across the airport teams you support.

• Leaders and managers putting the training and programs you build to real use.

• People processes running consistently at every station in your region.

 

What you're great at:

• 5+ years of HR or People Business Partner experience, including real time supporting hourly or frontline teams and handling complex employee relations matters.

• Earning trust with operational leaders quickly, and coaching them through hard calls with good judgment and empathy.

• Reading data and what people are actually telling you, then turning both into action.

The firm is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable Legal Assistant / Legal Secretary to support three equity partners in a sophisticated litigation practice.

The successful candidate will coordinate legal deadlines, prepare and proofread documents, electronically file pleadings in Florida state and federal courts, assist with prospective-client intake, organize case files, and help the attorneys and paralegal manage a varied litigation workload.
The immediate need may be met through a part-time schedule, particularly one that provides dependable coverage on Mondays and Fridays and includes some overlap with the firm’s existing paralegal. However, the firm is open to considering an excellent full-time candidate when the individual’s experience, capabilities, and compensation expectations align with the firm’s needs.
The ideal candidate can contribute quickly with limited training on fundamental litigation procedures. Strong candidates with exceptional client-intake experience may also be considered, even if their paralegal-level litigation experience is more limited.
Schedule and Work Arrangement
On-Site Requirement
This is an on-site position based in the firm’s West Palm Beach office near Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard.
Candidates should be able to commute reliably to the office. A commute of approximately 30 minutes is considered realistic for many candidates in the surrounding area.
Schedule Options
The firm is flexible based on the selected candidate’s availability and qualifications.
Option 1: Five-Day Morning Schedule
Monday through Friday.
Approximately 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
Provides daily continuity and overlap with the existing paralegal.
Option 2: Three-Day Schedule
Full-day coverage on Monday and Friday.
At least one additional weekday with overlap during Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday.

A full-time schedule may be considered for a highly qualified candidate capable of assuming a broader combination of litigation, intake, and administrative duties.
Regardless of the final arrangement, dependable Monday and Friday availability is an important requirement.
Compensation and Benefits
Compensation
Part-time compensation will be structured on an hourly basis.
The hourly rate will depend on the candidate’s litigation experience, court-filing knowledge, client-intake capabilities, schedule, and overall fit.
For reference, the firm indicated that a typical full-time starting salary would be approximately $50,000 annually.
Candidates should be prepared to provide their hourly or annual compensation expectations during the screening process.
Benefits
Part-Time Employees
The part-time position is not expected to include a standard benefits package.
Eligible Full-Time Employees
Benefits may include:
Firm-paid employee health insurance.
Paid holidays after the applicable eligibility period.
Paid vacation after the applicable eligibility period.
Health-insurance eligibility may depend on the employee’s weekly schedule and applicable plan requirements.

Litigation and Attorney Support
Provide legal and administrative support to three equity partners.
Coordinate with the firm’s paralegal, associate attorney, and other team members.
Manage attorney calendars and litigation schedules.
Schedule hearings, mediations, depositions, trials, conferences, consultations, and internal meetings.
Track court deadlines, filing deadlines, discovery deadlines, response dates, and other case-related obligations.
Review court rules, judicial standing orders, and filing instructions.
Prepare, format, proofread, revise, and finalize legal documents.

title: Physical AI R&D Engineer
description:
About Navflex

At Navflex, we're pioneering the future of logistics automation through cutting-edge AI and robotics. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) are transforming the way goods are loaded and unloaded, enabling plug-and-play solutions that streamline operations and enhance efficiency across the global supply chain for some of the world’s most demanding warehouse environments. Our international, cross‑disciplinary team in the EU and USA pairs robust mechatronics with cutting‑edge navigation and perception to deliver safe, reliable autonomy in real‑world warehouses and yards. Join us in shaping the future of intelligent logistics.

The Role

Our objective is autonomy in unstructured, real-world environments: vehicles that build a rich spatial understanding of their surroundings, reason about how they'll change, and act decisively within them. Progress compounds: fleet data becomes the substrate for world modeling and simulation, which lets us validate new behaviors faster than physical testing alone.

You'll work on problems where evaluation methodology is still evolving, and you'll contribute to shaping it alongside senior team members. We expect you to track the literature, judge what is ready for real hardware, carry results from prototype to validated capability, and work with core software engineering to bring it into production behind clear requirements and acceptance criteria. Staying current is part of the job, not something you do on your own time.

This is research and development, not research alone. We work on open problems, but always against a product roadmap, and a result counts when it reaches a vehicle and changes something a customer experiences. We move quickly, and nobody here disappears into a lab.

Focus Area: Spatial AI
Perception already runs on our vehicles across LiDAR, depth cameras, inertial sensing, and wheel odometry. You'll deepen its understanding: improve the accuracy and robustness of today's models, harden them against the conditions that degrade performance, and decide what should replace them.

The larger goal is a probabilistic 3D representation of the vehicle's surroundings that holds up over time: persisting through occlusion, decaying honestly when the world may have changed since it was last seen, and carrying calibrated uncertainty the rest of the stack can rely on. Warehouses are dynamic: pallets, people, and other vehicles move while unobserved. How it's encoded is an open question you'll help answer.

The same work extends into state estimation, where learned components complement the classical stack our autonomy team maintains: visual odometry, degeneracy prediction in geometrically weak environments, and pose uncertainty that's trustworthy rather than optimistic.

 

Success Measures

- Models you build run on production vehicles, with field behavior backed by evaluation developed in partnership with the team, with your own contributions clearly reflected in the results

- Capabilities you prototype reach production because you contribute clear, well-documented work that the team can build against

- You help evaluate external methods and contribute to team discussions on what's worth pursuing

 

What You’ll Do

- Take promising methods from the literature through prototype to validated on-vehicle capability, then partner with core software engineering to turn a proof of concept into production code

- Train, evaluate, and iterate on models using real fleet data: logs, rosbags, and multi-modal sensor streams from vehicles in production

- Build and maintain the 3D representation the rest of the stack consumes, with the calibration and sensor health monitoring it depends on

- Contribute to baselines and evaluation methodology, applying and refining standards set by the team

- Work with core software and test engineering on annotation pipelines, data infrastructure, and simulation tooling

 

What You’ll Bring

Required

- MS or higher in Computer Science, Robotics, Compute

Ihre Aufgaben
Leiten Sie Projekte, die wirklich etwas bewegen: Sie beraten unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Optimierung und Digitalisierung von Qualitätsmanagementsystemen und qualitätsrelevanten Geschäftsprozessen - von der QMS-Strategie über die eQMS-Implementierung bis hin zum Go-live auf Veeva Vault Quality und anderen führenden Plattformen.

Als Principal Consultant verantworten Sie komplexe Projekte und Programmteile über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg - von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur Implementierung und dem Go-live.
Sorgen Sie dafür, dass Veränderungen nachhaltig wirken: Sie analysieren bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse, erkennen Optimierungspotenziale und entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Lösungen. Gestalten Sie Compliance praxisnah: Sie beraten zu regulatorischen Anforderungen und Best Practices im Life-Sciences-Umfeld und entwickeln pragmatische Lösungen, die regulatorischen Anforderungen gerecht werden.
Gestalten Sie unser Wachstum mit: Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung in Presales-Aktivitäten, Angebotserstellungen und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios ein. title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Trust

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:
Everyone at Airbnb thinks about trust, but our team obsesses over it daily. At the core of trust is safety, and thus we spend a significant amount of our time and energy keeping the community safe. The Trust team is responsible for developing the technology that helps protect our community and platform from fraud while also ensuring our hosts, guests, homes, and experiences meet our high standards. We constantly work to fight against online fraud (such as monetary loss, compromised accounts, spam and scam in messages, fake inventory, etc.) as well as offline fraud (theft, property damage, personal safety, etc.). We also work on onboarding and screening of users, and think about complex topics like identity and reputation to ensure that every interaction with Airbnb helps build trust in us and our community. Trust Engineering is responsible for the technology vision and development of a complex stack that runs on every key interaction on the platform.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a senior technical individual contributor, you will partner closely with our leaders across the broader technical organization helping design, execute and deliver in a complex and collaborative roadmap of Trust engineering efforts that will require collaboration across many parts of the organization and many parts of Airbnb . Although you will be at one of our highest levels of seniority, all individual contributors at Airbnb are Software Engineers which means we expect you to be hands on and contribute code.

• Dive deep into Trust Platform components, build system and performance tooling, and identify cross-cutting opportunities to elevate technical quality, operational excellence, and developer delight.

• Champion an AI-first engineering approach, using LLM-powered agents to generate and iterate on code while you focus on problem-solving, system design, and quality oversight.

• Partner with technical leaders, product managers, operations, data scientists, and Trust defense & ML teams to define and drive platform capabilities, tackle evolving fraud threats, and deliver measurable business impact

• Lead and mentor engineers across teams, raising the technical bar and developing the next generation of technical leaders within the trust engineering ecosystem.

Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of backend & platform engineering designing, building, and operating mission-critical distributed systems at scale.

• BS, MS or Ph.D. in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience

• Obsessed with reliability: deep experience building and improving observability, SLOs, incident response, and resilience patterns (circuit breakers, graceful degradation, chaos testing) to keep mission-critical systems running at the highest bar.

description: Fazeshift | Senior Software Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE (5 days/week) | Full-time | $200k-$235k + equity I’m Chris, VP Engineering at Fazeshift. We’re nine engineers plus our Founder/CTO and me, and I’m hiring someone who can help us do more, better: increase both what we can build and the quality and sophistication of the software we build. Accounts receivable sounds boring until you look under the hood. It sits at the intersection of money, business relationships, software systems of various vintages, and a huge amount of repetitive human work. Instead of giving finance teams another dashboard to stare at, we’re building AI agents that actually do the work across billing, collections, payments, cash application, and the systems connecting them. We’ve grown revenue 12x since 2024, and eight unicorns now run AR on Fazeshift. A big part of what makes the engineering interesting is that we’re intentionally not the system of record. Our customers already run on ERPs, CRMs, banks, billing systems, payment processors, spreadsheets, and internal software, so we have to understand state across systems we don’t control, act safely in them, and recover when reality disagrees with what an API says should have happened. A timeout doesn’t necessarily mean a write failed. Webhooks can arrive late or twice. A payment may not contain enough information to identify an invoice. In those cases, blindly retrying can be exactly the wrong thing to do. We use coding agents heavily ourselves. Engineers use Conductor, stacked PRs, Linear, and multiple frontier models every day, with internal skills and tooling that let agents drive and validate our local development environment. We’re especially interested in engineers whose development workflow has already materially changed because of coding agents: people who are comfortable delegating meaningful work, keeping independent threads moving in parallel, debugging where agents get stuck, and improving the surrounding system when the workflow breaks down. But generated code is still your code . Judgment, debugging, systems thinking, taste, and understanding what actually shipped matter more here, not less. Our development style is roughly: design enough to find the shape of the problem, then build to learn. There’s a short distance here between noticing a problem, deciding what should happen, building it, and seeing the result in production with our customers. You’ll own meaningful problems from ambiguity through design, implementation, rollout, and production, and you’ll work directly with the people affected by what you build. We’re looking for 5+ years of professional experience, strong TypeScript/full-stack skills, solid systems judgment, and real production ownership. No fintech background needed. Stack: TypeScript/Next.js, tRPC, Prisma/MySQL/PlanetScale, Inngest, AWS. I read every HN application myself. Email chris.zehner@fazeshift.com with HN in the subject, your LinkedIn/GitHub/résumé, and a few sentences about something interesting you’ve built or improved recently.

The Data Centre of Excellence requires a resource to support the design and development of analytical data products & services to enable the GoA to better leverage its data assets support implementation of the GoA Data Strategy. Working within a team, this resource is an expert, and plays a key role in ensuring high-quality data modeling, applying algorithms, de-identification, synthetic data creation, visualizations and development of evidence for use across ministries and with external stakeholders. This role will enact the pillars of the Data Strategy by using data to benefit Albertans
The successful candidate will be a Machine Learning Specialist with a diverse range of analytical skills and experience in working in multi-faceted roles. The role may have aspects of any or all the following: machine learning (ML) model development, artificial intelligence (AI), data analysis, data science, AI development, data engineering, data modelling, statistical analysis, &, strategizing, advising, and data product design and delivery. There may be aspects of data architecture, technical analysis, and business analysis.
Duties :
Provides hands-on support, leadership, advice and direction on the strategic data initiatives that are being undertaken. A critical responsibility is to coordinate with various internal and external clients to understand their analytics needs and how to use the data to best meet these needs. The MLS creates tools, models, and analysis to apply artificial intelligence for better government policy and services. The MLS will work with cross-functional project teams to apply machine learning (ML). Services and project deliverables should evolve as the work progresses, in response to emerging user and business needs, as well as design and technical opportunities. Works with Manager Analytics Capability Centre to:

• Helps teams identify when (and when not) to apply ML, including identifying prerequisites for good ML applications.

• Facilitates, coaches, and mentors others in the application of ML to complex public challenges.

• Helps identify and select ML tools, services, and infrastructure.

• Creates data collection, normalization, and cleaning procedures.

• Creates training scripts and train models for specific domains using chosen ML packages.

• Runs ML driven analyses of large datasets and reports on findings.

• Creates ML analytics, reports, and insights to inform better services and policymaking.

• Integrates trained ML models within applications.

• Develops auditing, accountability, and transparency mechanisms for ML capabilities.

• Works within privacy legislation and provides ethical as well as practical guidance on ML implementation.

• Develop and share analytical models and products.

• Analyze and organize raw data, preparing it for prescriptive and predictive modeling, while building algorithms that deliver business value.

• Support in development of full-stack data analytics or AI applications as required.

• Provide expertise and leadership in the design and competition of analytic projects.

• Conducting complex data analysis and collaborating with data engineers and analysts on various projects.

• Bring knowledge of statistical classification techniques such as k-means and hierarchical clustering, partition trees, and logistic regression.

• Gather and document client requirements.

• Capture business and technical metadata for ML products.

• Escalate issues and risks, as appropriate.

title: Strategic Account Executive, Capital Partnerships
description:
About Upstart

At Upstart , we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:
Upstart ’s Lending Partnerships team connects our technology and credit expertise with the capital and customer relationships of banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. We are growing our team and seeking a Strategic Account Executive, Capital Partnerships to help build and expand these partnerships across our target market
You will lead efforts to identify, attract, and develop new bank and credit union partnerships to expand our depository capital base, with a focus on new products. You will structure and execute thoughtful deals that align with each financial institution's funding needs, risk appetite, and strategic objectives. Working cross-functionally with teams across Upstart , you will turn high-potential opportunities into durable partnerships and meaningful sources of capital.
How you’ll make an impact

• Identify and qualify prospective partners based on their funding needs, risk appetite, strategic priorities, and interest in new products

• Drive negotiations and close strategic partnerships that expand Upstart ’s capital network and unlock new growth opportunities across products and channels

• Build and cultivate relationships with executives and decision-makers at banks and credit unions.

• Develop compelling partnership strategies and business cases that demonstrate the value of working with Upstart

• Collaborate with Solutions Consulting, Product, Legal, Credit, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to design and structure lender-aligned deals

Minimum Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in leading and managing complex lending deals, corporate strategy, or business development strategy roles preferably at financial services institutions

• Established relationships with senior decision-makers across banks, credit unions, and related financial institutions

• Strong understanding of how depository institutions evaluate lending partnerships, including funding needs, risk appetite, economics, and strategic priorities

• Ability to independently build pipeline, develop a market strategy, and drive complex deals from initial outreach through close

• Demonstrated ability to develop compelling business cases and influence stakeholders across both partner organizations and internal cross-functional teams

• Strong judgment, executive presence, and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex, high-visibility transactions
